Summary: Grace is God's undeserved favour freely given to sinners, the heartbeat of the gospel from beginning to end. We are justified by grace, sustained by grace, and taught by grace to say no to ungodliness and yes to godliness. Grace humbles the proud, lifts the lowly, and leaves no room for boasting except in Christ.
KeyPassages: Genesis 6:8; Psalm 84:11; John 1:16-17; Romans 5:20; Ephesians 2:8; Titus 2:11-12
RelatedBooks: Genesis; Psalms; John; Romans; Ephesians; Titus
RelatedEvents: The Crucifixion; Conversion of Saul (Paul); Pentecost
